Add Related Identifiers to a Zenodo Record

Source: R/addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers.R
addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers.Rd

addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers() adds related identifiers to the metadata of a Zenodo record, e.g. an IsPartOf link from a campaign data package to the owner collection it belongs to, or a HasPart link from a collection to a campaign. Related identifiers that the record already has are not added twice; existing ones are kept.

Only the metadata are changed: the files, the DOI and the version of the record stay the same, so no new version is needed. The latest version of the record is updated, whichever version's DOI (or the concept DOI) is given.

  • For a published record, the function opens an edit of the record and updates its metadata. With publish = FALSE (default), the edit stays open: check it on Zenodo and publish it there (or discard it). With publish = TRUE, the edit is published directly.

  • For an unpublished draft, the metadata of the draft are updated. The draft is never published, also not with publish = TRUE.

Usage

addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers(
  doi,
  relatedIdentifiers,
  token = NULL,
  sandbox = FALSE,
  publish = FALSE
)

Arguments

doi

DOI (e.g. "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1234567" or "10.5281/zenodo.1234567") or record ID of the Zenodo record.

relatedIdentifiers

related identifiers to add: a list of lists, each with relationType (DataCite relation type, e.g. "IsPartOf", "HasPart", "IsCitedBy") and relatedIdentifier (e.g. a DOI URL), as in the metadata file of a data package; or a data frame with these two columns.

token

Zenodo personal access token with the scopes deposit:write and deposit:actions. Default is the environment variable ZENODO_TOKEN (or ZENODO_SANDBOX_TOKEN if sandbox = TRUE). Never write the token in a script.

sandbox

logical. If TRUE, use the Zenodo sandbox (https://sandbox.zenodo.org). Default is FALSE.

publish

logical. If TRUE, the edit of a published record is published directly. Default is FALSE: the edit stays open on Zenodo.

Value

A list, invisibly, with id (Zenodo record ID), url (link to the record on Zenodo), added (number of related identifiers added) and published (logical, whether the edit was published).

See also

Other write file functions: compileData(), createDataPackage(), createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(), saveMTR(), savePlotToFile(), uploadDataPackageToZenodo(), validateDataPackage()

Author

Birgen Haest

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Link a campaign data package to its owner collection (Zenodo sandbox)
# ===========================================================================
addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers(
  doi = "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1234567",
  relatedIdentifiers = list(list(
    relationType      = "IsPartOf",
    relatedIdentifier = "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7654321"
  )),
  sandbox = TRUE
)
} # }
